verdict.rationale: Teller is a bank-data and payments API, and an event-driven rules capability is a fair question for it, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no rules engine and no way to define conditions that automatically trigger actions. Its webhooks (teller-docs-7, teller-docs-17) only notify a developer's URL about enrollment or data changes. That is a building block a developer would have to turn into rules themselves, so it earns no credit.
